_comment: Hand-maintained region rules (server\regions.js, ck-mcp\regions.py, ck-mcp\loot.py). Keys are editor ids or mp descs (lowercase hex, e.g. 5ace4:Skyrim.esm). A value is 'common' (everywhere), 'none' (never sold or craftable), a province, a culture from aliases, or a list of them. Applied at runtime on save: items, recipes, tomes, places, benches. Applied only after regenerating (py ck-mcp\loot.py, then py ck-mcp\regions.py): families, aliases, coreSpells; the generators also apply items.

items._decor: Home decorating's materials (decor.js, 25 Oct): Quartz is mined in Skyrim and Cyrodiil, the two provinces players build in; glass is smelted from it wherever it is found, and straw is threshed from wheat everywhere. Keyed by editor id: the DLE's load-order prefix can move.
items._staples: Butter, flour and milk are made and sold all over Tamriel (lore); only Hearthfire's own lists put them in Skyrim, so 17 Cook recipes could not be made in the Bruma lock (Worker F's cooking census, 30 Sep).
items._tomebound: Tomebound's scrolls and staves (merged into the DLE, Nat 25 Oct), by the same lore rule as its tomes: Skyrim's own creatures and the Volkihar arts in Skyrim, the rest in Cyrodiil. Applied at runtime and by ck-mcp/loot.py.

recipes._telvanniGuardGear: House Telvanni's guard gear (Journey to Baan Malur pieces, DragonBreak Nexus Patches recipes 849-84e, faction gear house-telvanni): regions.json sells its recipes in Solstheim only (culture morrowind), but House Telvanni has been seated at Golden Glow Estate by Riften since 25 Oct (Nat), so its smiths in Skyrim could not make their own gear. Made in Solstheim and Skyrim now; still gated to House Telvanni by faction gear (the Leader for Nat, 26 Oct: fix gear discrepancies).
recipes._greatHouseCapes: The Great House capes (DLE 1D2266-1D226E, tanning rack; the Leader, 26 Oct, on Worker 2's proposal): the seven house capes are made anywhere, gated only by faction gear to their own house's tailors (Telvanni's hall, Golden Glow Estate, is in the Riften zone, so a Solstheim lock would stop its own Clothier); Dagoth and the New Temple, which no faction holds, stay Morrowind's, Solstheim. By recipe desc, so the rule holds before and after regions.json is regenerated.
recipes._nordic: Nordic carved gear (smithing.json family nordic: Dragonborn's recipes and the server's Nord1/Nord2 sets) is forged in Skyrim as well as Solstheim, as Dwarven and Dragon are: its schematic is found in Skyrim's Nordic barrows and by reading, so a smith who learned it in Skyrim was refused there as "a Solstheim design" (/bug #BGJN, 24 Oct). regions.json marks Dragonborn's recipes Solstheim by the plugin.
recipes._falchion: CYRIronFalchion's model is untextured in Beyond Skyrim Bruma (#bugs "Iron Falchion Missing Textures", 1 Oct 2026): it is out of loot (loot-overrides.json) and not forged either until the model is fixed.
recipes._colovianRed: DBOLOOM_CYR_ColovianNobleClothes01 makes BSAssets.esm's red Colovian Fine Clothes (602974), whose female model is a first-person mesh, so a woman wearing them is mostly invisible (#bugs 7 Oct 2026). Woven nowhere until a plugin override fixes the addon; the same-looking BSHeartland twin (DBOLOOM_CYRColovianNobleClothes01, 885) is still woven. Keyed by desc, which names this one recipe whether or not regions.json lists it (its editor id differs from the twin's by one underscore).
recipes._reskins: The PC's metal reskins (9 Oct): Bronze on Ancient Nord shapes and Brass on Dwarven shapes took their shape's provinces (Skyrim, Solstheim), so they could not be forged in the Bruma lock; their metals are common, and so are they.
recipes._bags: The bags and the Travelling Merchant Backpack moved to the loom (the PC, 9 Oct): their shapes put them in Skyrim (Everglaid's) and Solstheim (Armors of the Velothi), but bags are made all over Tamriel, so they are common (craftable in the Bruma lock).
recipes._skyrimRelease: Skyrim release (15 Oct). DBOSM_Res_GoldIngotDB (b75) smelts DragonBreak.esp's IngotGoldStatic, which stands only as bank-vault dressing (Whiterun, Riften and Solitude banks): refused, so a vault's decor never becomes gold (the PC also made the 13 vault bars unpickable, DLE 641f3719). The Black Bear light hoods (d99, d97) are no longer refused: Armory v9 fe2eb7dd gives them a Steel ingot and the Lowered one the light hood.
recipes._skyrim140: regions.json from ck-mcp/regions.py on the 140-plugin order (PC, 15 Oct) tags these peoples' recipes by their shapes (Black Bear, Adamantium: Skyrim; the Armory goblin armour: Cyrodiil; four Yoku pieces: Skyrim, Solstheim or Cyrodiil). Who makes them is config raceCraft (Nords, Goblins, Redguards; the Adamantium Addon every race), anywhere, so they are common here, as recipePlugins had them before regions.json listed them.

recipePlugins._comment: Province and culture for the creation recipes of a plugin regions.json does not list yet (regions.js pluginRule): { "<recipe's plugin>": { p, c, edid?, notEdid?, why } or a list of them, the first whose edid / notEdid regexes match wins }. Empty since the 140-order regions.json (PC, 15 Oct) lists every Skyrim-release plugin; the few recipes it tags too narrowly are common under recipes (_skyrim140). Applied on save.

tomes._saintsSeducers: Kept Skyrim's (9 Oct) until Nate says: ck-mcp's 9 Oct regen tagged these Saints and Seducers conjure tomes Cyrodiil, which would stock them in the Synod.
tomes._tomebound: The Elder Scrolls - Tomebound (Nexus 21403, merged into the DLE, Nat 25 Oct): by lore origin. Skyrim: the Draugr, Wispmother, Corrupted Shade and Death Hound summons and the Volkihar vampiric arts; Cyrodiil, sold in the Synod now: the rest.
tomes._liveOrder1026: spell-tomes.json regenerated on the live 143-plugin order (26 Oct, Leader for Nat; tooling/ck-mcp/spell_tomes.py) added 114 tomes regions.json does not know, which failOpen would have sold everywhere, the Synod included. By the file pattern and lore: Druadach (the Reach), Arnima, Summerset Isles, King of the Murkmire and the Summer Druid set in Skyrim, not the Synod; BSAssets Toxic Missile in Cyrodiil as the other 16 BSAssets tomes; Ice Storm in Cyrodiil and Skyrim as Fireball and Chain Lightning; Flame Cloak in Skyrim as Frost and Lightning Cloak; Gray Fox Cowl as its other tomes and the YokuWeapons internals: none.

forgeNever._comment: Products no recipe makes or improves, for anyone, staff and the item's own faction included (regions.js craftHook, before every other rule; applied on save). Key: product desc or editor id; value: { name shown, why, told (optional: the whole line the smith is told, else '<name> ... far stronger than intended') }. Audit lines: FORGENEVER craft refused.
